# Frozen test fixtures

Files here are committed on purpose and are **not** regenerated by any tool. A
fixture that a build regenerates cannot prove backwards compatibility, because it
would always be produced by the current code.

## `save_schema1_frozen.json`

A schema 1 save, as written by Milestone 03 before the world data was reorganised
into per-country folders (see `docs/COUNTRY_FOLDER_GUIDE.md`).

* Campaign: Modern World, Bangladesh (`BGD`), start date 1 January 2026.
* In-game date at the save: 1 March 2026, speed 2, seed 424242.
* Wallet: 250 gold coins, 7 diamonds; playtime 3 600 s.
* Data stamp: `ca96624/242/99567/21536263` — the stamp of the shipped world data.

It was produced by writing the schema 1 payload and computing its checksum with a
standalone implementation of the canonical JSON rules in
`src/core/sim/canonical_json.gd` (sorted keys, whole numbers as integers, floats
with a decimal point, SHA-256 over the result). The engine then verified it: the
suite loads this exact file, migrates it in memory and checks every value above.

`test_a_frozen_older_save_still_loads` in `tests/suites/test_save_system.gd` is
the test that uses it. If that test fails, the change that broke it needs a
migration step — never a new fixture.
